purpose: The smallest seed of the LaTeX vector space: every known physics/eng formula becomes a POINT (a node), and its derivation/prerequisite links become EDGES (graph math to all interconnections). We query this dataset as we build, because all math is interconnected. Start small (the THEA v1.1 formulas), iterate to all of physics highschool->QCD. html+js+KaTeX, zero deps: once the net is paid in compute, the browser renders as much as you pay for.
